cues.en: Alright, mister Wilson. You've done just
cues.zh: 好了，Wilson先生。你的罗夏测试

cues.en: fine on the Rorschach. Your papers are in good order. The file's fine.
cues.zh: 做得不错。你的文件都齐全。档案没问题。

cues.en: No difficulty with your motor skills,
and I think you're probably pretty ready for this job. We got one more
cues.zh: 我觉得你大概已经准备好干这份工作了。我们还剩

cues.en: kind of psychological test we always do here. It's just a word association. I'll throw you out a few words. Anything that comes to your mind, just throw back at me. Okay? Just kind of an arbitrary thing. Like, if I said dog, you'd say Tree. Tree.
cues.zh: 一项这里常做的心理测试。就是词语联想。我会说几个词。你想到什么，就直接说给我听。好吗？就是随便联想。比如我说狗，你就说树。树。

cues.en: I think you're qualified for this job.
cues.zh: 我觉得你完全胜任这份工作。

cues.en: How about a starting salary of $5,000? Your mama.
cues.zh: 起薪五千美元怎么样？你妈。

cues.en: mister Wilson. You'll be the highest paid janitor in America. Just don't don't hurt me, please.
cues.zh: 威尔逊先生。你会成为美国薪水最高的清洁工。别、别伤害我，求你了。

cues.en: You want me to start now? Oh, no. No. No. It's alright. I'll clean all this up. I'll take a couple of weeks off. You look tired.
cues.zh: 你要我现在开始吗？噢，不用，不用，没事的。我会把这里收拾干净，然后休两周假。你看起来很累。
